## A. Where identity guidance and checks live (sourced facts, read this session)

It tells the root to set them with `git config` if missing and says `vcs commit` refuses an agent's identity.
- Line 5 of the same file covers text rules (no agent, Claude or attribution), not identity.
- `/home/user/holyagent/packages/runtime/src/instructions/requirements.md:31` is R-VCS: "...the user's own Git identity".
- `/home/user/holyagent/packages/runtime/src/instructions/requirements/commit-text.md:5` says the author and committer are the user's configured identity and that `vcs commit` insists on it. It is an input to the instructions, not shipped as agent text (`docs/development.md:16`, `docs/pi/claude-parity.md:127`).

## B. Cloud-session detection (what the repo shows)

- **No code branch exists.** A grep of `packages` for `CLAUDE_CODE_REMOTE` found nothing, and the only env reads in the runtime are `process.env` pass-throughs in `git.ts:29` and `github.ts:31` and the host env at `main.ts:37`.
- **The hook can already see the env.** `call.env` is a `Readonly<Record<string, string | undefined>>` (`types.ts:50`).
- **The handoff env vars are taken from the handoff only.** Inference: `CLAUDE_CODE_REMOTE=true` is the natural switch. `CLAUDE_CODE_REMOTE_ENVIRONMENT_TYPE=cloud_default` is a secondary signal.
- **There is repo evidence of cloud-specific behavior.** `docs/usage.md:90` names `CLAUDE_CODE_PROVIDER_MANAGED_BY_HOST` for cloud sessions. `docs/commit-authorship.md:71` notes the cloud proxy rewrites PR bodies.

## C. Where a claude.ai branch would go (inference)

The goal is guidance in claude.ai only, with the local machine identity used elsewhere.

1. **Move the identity bullet out of static text.**
   - Remove it from `root/version-control.md:9`, `requirements.md:31` and `commit-text.md:5`. Keep the local default as "use the configured git identity".
   - Emit the cloud-specific wording only from `session-start` in `hook.ts:195` to `233`. When `call.env.CLAUDE_CODE_REMOTE === "true"`, add a line to the `additionalContext` (all three outputs at `hook.ts:214`, `217` and `223` share the `SESSION_REMINDER` tail). Add it in `sessioncontext.ts` as a small constant, similar to `ROOT_TAKEOVER`.
   - `CONTEXT_BUDGET` is 9300 (`sessioncontext.ts:9`), so a short line fits.
   - Rebuild dist with `mise run build`.
2. **Behavior of the refusal.**
   - Locally, an agent-looking identity should keep failing `AgentIdentity`, since a local `Claude` identity is a misconfiguration.
   - In the cloud, the preconfigured `Claude <noreply@anthropic.com>` always trips `commit.ts:33`. Today this forces `git config` in the repo before every cloud commit.
   - Options for the root to pick:
     - (a) keep the refusal and have the cloud guidance say to set the owner's identity;
     - (b) skip `requireOwnIdentity` when `CLAUDE_CODE_REMOTE=true`, passing the env into `commit` (a signature change in `commit.ts:71` and its caller);
     - (c) set `GIT_AUTHOR_*` and `GIT_COMMITTER_*` from a known owner.
   - Option (b) weakens the attribution guarantee, so it needs the root's decision.
3. **Tests and docs.** Add a `hook session-start` test with `CLAUDE_CODE_REMOTE` set and unset (see `packages/integrations/claude/tests/hooks.test.ts`). Update `docs/commit-authorship.md:17` and `docs/usage.md:90`.
